sentences.text: 1 provisions under Sections 409, 420, 120-B and 477-A of Indian Order cri wp 811.2025+2.odt Penal Code.

The investigation is carried out under following heads, amongst others :
(1) concealment and misrepresentation of non performing assets.

(2) diversion of depositors fund, (3) losses incurred in non-banking businesses, (4)
violations of statutory transactions, regulatory provisions and (5) irregularities in asset management and dividend distribution.
3. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor (APP) submits that investigation on the point of irregularities in asset management and dividend distribution is in process and some time will be required.

When enquired, as to how much more time will SIT take to complete investigation,
learned APP, on instructions from Mr. Anupkumar Sing, ADG, submits that investigation will be completed within two months from today.
The statement is accepted.
However, we expect SIT to complete investigation within one month from today.
4. Further and considering the nature of allegations and the scope of investigation, we deem it appropriate to appoint Mr. P. R. Agrawal, Advocate as amicus.
He is present in the Court and has graciously accepted to act as amicus.

5. The Registry shall furnish copy of petitions and the status report of investigation to the amicus,
Order cri wp 811.2025+2.odt who shall go through the same and apprise us of the niceties involved in the matter.
6. SIT may also take advice-cum-guidance from the amicus.

7. List on 24-3-2026.
 (JUDGE) (JUDGE.)
 wasnik Sau.
